description: inveXo Portable 12V DC Car Tyre Inflator | 150 PSI | 120W Copper Motor | 35L/min | 3 Metre Cable | LED Emergency Light | Analogue Gauge | No Battery | No Charging NEVER GET STRANDED WITH A FLAT TYRE AGAIN The inveXo AP4 is a heavy duty portable tyre inflator built for Indian roads and real emergencies. Powerful enough for cars, SUVs, trucks, and motorcycles. Compact enough for your glovebox. Bright enough to work in complete darkness. Plug into your car cigarette lighter socket and inflate any tyre fast — day or night. 150 PSI | 120W COPPER MOTOR | 35L/MIN AIRFLOW Powered by a 120W pure copper motor delivering 150 PSI maximum pressure at 35 litres per minute airflow — one of the fastest airflow rates in its class. Copper winding ensures better heat resistance, longer motor life, and stable performance across hundreds of inflations. Dual heat dissipation ventilation grilles on the body ensure the motor stays cool even during continuous use. 12V DC PLUG-IN | 3 METRE CABLE | NO BATTERY NEEDED Runs directly from your car cigarette lighter socket at full 120W power every single time. No internal battery. Not rechargeable. No power loss. No waiting. The extra long 3 metre power cable gives you complete reach to all four tyres and your spare stepney without moving the vehicle. Max current draw 10A. Compatible with all standard 12V DC cigarette lighter sockets across all car brands in India. BUILT-IN LED EMERGENCY FLASHLIGHT The AP4 has a high-intensity LED emergency flashlight built directly into the pump body. When you have a flat tyre on a dark highway, unlit road, or low-visibility situation — switch on the LED light and work safely. Bright white light. Hands-free. No separate torch needed. This single feature makes the AP4 a genuine roadside safety companion — not just a tyre pump. ANALOGUE PIN-POINTER PRESSURE GAUGE The high-accuracy analogue dial gauge gives you real-time tyre pressure readings in PSI, BAR, and KPA. No app. No Bluetooth. No digital screen. No battery needed to read pressure. The physical pin-pointer needle gives precise instant readings so you always inflate to the exact recommended pressure for your car, SUV, bike, or motorcycle tyre. Prevents under-inflation and over-inflation — better mileage, longer tyre life, safer driving. 50CM REINFORCED HOSE | 3 NOZZLE ADAPTERS | SMART STORAGE The 50CM heavy duty braided air hose with metal Schrader connector fits all standard car tyre valves, bike valves, and motorcycle valves securely without air leakage. Includes 3 nozzle adapters for inflating sports balls, bicycles, inflatable toys, swimming rings, and air mattresses. The smart back panel features a dedicated air hose storage slot and a separate DC cable storage channel — keeping everything tangle free and organised every time you store the pump. DURABLE BUILD | ANTI-VIBRATION FEET | COMPACT DESIGN Impact-resistant ABS plastic body with metal parts for long-lasting performance. Anti-vibration rubber bumper feet on all four corners keep the pump stable on any surface during inflation — tarmac, concrete, or boot lining. Compact 150x73x210mm body fits easily in car boot, glovebox, or under-seat storage. Your permanent roadside emergency companion for Indian roads. WIDE COMPATIBILITY Air pump for car, bike, SUV, jeep, truck, motorcycle, scooter, bicycle, cycle, football, basketball, volleyball, inflatable toy, swimming ring, air mattress, air bed, and all tubeless and tube tyre inflatables. Compatible with Swift, Creta, Nexon, Brezza, Innova, Scorpio, Fortuner, and all standard Indian hatchbacks, sedans, and SUVs. 1 YEAR WARRANTY by inveXo
